summary: Arvyx MCP currently supports JSON-RPC request/response over stdio and HTTP. Streaming transports are not advertised.

transports.name: direct-stdio
transports.notes: Best fit for local read-only MCP clients.

transports.name: http-json-rpc
transports.notes: Used by the local Control Center API and safe-mcp-bridge upstream.

transports.name: safe-mcp-bridge-stdio-to-http
transports.notes: Best fit when a stdio client needs a scoped HTTP MCP upstream.

transports.name: sse
transports.notes: Not implemented in the alpha release.
